activity_statements.statement: manufactures and sells pet nutrition products under brands including Royal Canin, Pedigree, Whiskas, Cesar, and Waltham through 100,000+ Petcare associates serving half the world's pets
operates VCA, AniCura, and Banfield Pet Hospital veterinary clinic chains providing clinical veterinary care and specialty animal health services
manufactures and sells confectionery and snacking products including M&M's, Snickers, Twix, Milky Way, Skittles, Starburst, Extra gum, Kind bars, and Pringles (via Kellanova acquisition)
produces and sells food and nutrition products including Ben's Original rice, Dolmio pasta sauces, and Tasty Bite meal products
operates as a private, family-owned company for over 100 years with approximately 150,000 associates and no public financial disclosure
completed acquisition of Kellanova (maker of Pringles, Pop-Tarts, Cheez-It, RXBAR) in 2024/2025, substantially expanding the snacking segment

name_reality_gap: The name 'Mars' evokes chocolate and candy, but by headcount and arguably by revenue the company is now as much a pet care company as a confectionery company — it operates a network of veterinary hospitals and is the world's largest pet food company. The index label 'Manufacturing & Energy' is technically accurate for some activities but completely misses the veterinary clinical services dimension.
extraction_notes: Only the about page was accessible (history and what-we-do pages returned 404). Brands detail sourced from ExaAnswer research synthesis (mars.com/our-brands). Mars is a private company with no public financial statements. Segment weight estimates are rough.
